title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：pancake　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pancake 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the baker ① made the pancake that no customer in the bakery would have recorded, and he said the making was the whole of the week. The ② pancake, meaning the cake itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a pancake, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ pancake in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ pancake at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pancake, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the baker said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pancake was the whole of the matter, meaning the treat and not the cake. The ⑥ pancake, meaning the treat and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pancake, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a cake and a treat. He said the treat is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ pancake had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ pancake of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of recording; pancake, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pancake I remember is the cake recorded in the bill, which closed in 1960 and is still recorded as the quietest in the bakery. A ⑩ pancake, my mother said in 1962, is the only cake that improves by being recorded; every pancake, she said, is a treat that has agreed to look like a cake. She said the treat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 薄饼；煎饼（指糕饼铺里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 薄饼；煎饼（指那张薄饼本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the pancake 摊这一张薄饼
D. n. 薄饼；煎饼（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 薄饼之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的薄饼之事）
F. n. 薄饼；煎饼（指账单里写到、被记载的那一张）
G. n. 薄饼、款待（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 款待（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the pancake that no customer in the bakery would have recorded

answers.why: make the pancake 意为“摊这一张薄饼”，1953 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯记载的一张薄饼做了一遍。
pancake 意为“薄饼；煎饼”，指那张薄饼本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
pancake 意为“薄饼；煎饼”，指糕饼铺里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
pancake 意为“薄饼；煎饼”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pancake 意为“薄饼、款待”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张款待就是那件事的全部。
pancake 意为“款待”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张薄饼，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pancake 意为“薄饼；煎饼”，指账单里写到、被记载的那一张，到 1958 年这一张成了账单里的一行。
pancake 意为“薄饼之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的薄饼之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的记载。
pancake 意为“薄饼；煎饼”，我记得的是账单里记载过的那一张，1960 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一张。
pancake 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，薄饼是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的薄饼。
